activities.caption: find the faulty line — the mule answer
activities.name: spMuleSpot

config.prompt: This hybrid-sterility answer contains one faulty line — click it:
lines: A horse has 64 chromosomes; a donkey has 62.
At meiosis, the odd number leaves chromosomes without matching partners.
Meiosis fails, so the mule is sterile.
Because the failure happens after fertilisation, this is a prezygotic barrier.
Hybrid breakdown goes further: a fertile first generation, failing grandchildren.
config.correction: After fertilisation means POSTzygotic — prezygotic barriers act before fertilisation.
config.why: Postzygotic barriers waste hybrids after they form: inviability, sterility (the mule), breakdown. Prezygotic barriers — temporal, behavioural, mechanical, gametic — stop fertilisation from ever happening.

activities.caption: pair each case with its geography of speciation
activities.name: spGeoMatch

config.prompt: Four textbook cases, three routes — pair them:

pairs.left: a canyon, a river or an archipelago cuts gene flow
Hawaii's thousand-plus Drosophila species from a few founders
apple maggot host races mating on their own fruit in the same orchard
a meiosis accident doubles the chromosome set; the tetraploid selfs

config.why: Allopatric is the workhorse; sympatric needs assortative mating to beat gene flow; polyploidy skips the waiting entirely — bread wheat is hexaploid, 2n = 42 from three ancestral genomes.

activities.caption: true or false — reading the tree
activities.name: spCladeJudge

statements.s: A clade is an ancestor and all of its descendants.
statements.why: The monophyletic group — the only grouping cladistics trusts.

statements.s: Shared ancestral traits, like backbones in mammals and fish, indicate common ancestry of those two groups.
statements.why: Backbones predate both — ancestral traits indicate nothing about grouping; only shared derived traits (synapomorphies) mark a branching.

statements.s: 'Reptiles' fail as a clade because they exclude birds.
statements.why: Drop the descendants and you lose the monophyly — which is why 'birds are dinosaurs' is a cladistic statement.

statements.s: Long-branch attraction and incomplete lineage sorting are known artefacts that can mislead trees.
statements.why: Trees are hypotheses — fast-evolving lineages misgroup, and gene trees can disagree with species trees.

activities.caption: call the magnitude — the Neanderthal share
activities.name: spNeanderEstimate

config.prompt: Ancient DNA shows our ancestors mixed with Neanderthals. Roughly what percentage of a non-African human genome is Neanderthal DNA?
config.why: ~2% — introgression caught across a species boundary, alongside Denisovan mixing in the same genomes.
config.context: Trees are real, reticulation is real — and the two are quantitatively separable.

activities.caption: bet first — what does the tree actually say?
activities.name: spChimpPredict

config.q: Which statement does the phylogenetic tree actually support?
choices: Humans and chimpanzees share a common ancestor that lived roughly 6–7 million years ago
Chimpanzees stopped evolving while humans kept progressing
config.why: A living relative is a cousin, not a grandparent: both lineages have been evolving since the split, so chimpanzees carry six million years of their own history — the tree has no top rung.

activities.caption: rebuild the drought season on Daphne Major
activities.name: spFinchOrder

config.prompt: 1977, measured microevolution — put the season in order:
items: The 1977 drought on Daphne Major kills ~85% of the medium ground finches
The surviving seeds are hard — only large-billed birds can crack them
The breeder's equation R = h²S sets up the prediction (h² ≈ 0.7)
The next generation's mean bill comes out ~4% deeper, as the equation demanded
Wet years reverse the selection and the mean swings back
Forty years of measurement: bill size tracks seed hardness season by season
config.why: Speciation on a weather record: measured selection, heritability h² ≈ 0.7, and a radiation whose endpoint — thirteen species — is isolated mostly by song learned from the father.

activities.anchor: What does speciation look like in rocks?
activities.caption: stasis, then punctuation — drag across the record
activities.name: spFossilCompare

config.prompt: Eldredge and Gould, 1972 — drag the divider across the fossil record:

before.label: stasis
before.text: Morphological stability over millions of years — the species holds its shape bed after bed.

after.label: punctuation
after.text: Geologically abrupt appearances of descendant species, mostly in small peripheral populations whose transitions the record rarely catches.

config.why: Four decades of data resolved the debate as a question of rates: both anagenesis and cladogenesis occur, the branching mode dominates, and the apparent gaps are partly the geometry of speciation — small, fast, local.

activities.anchor: every COVID variant of concern was a phylogenetic classification
activities.caption: spend one tree four ways
activities.name: spAppliedBranch

config.root: A genome lands on your desk — a pathogen, a rare mammal, a shipment of timber, a medicinal plant. The tree is a working tool. Choose an application.

start.text: Which job do you send the tree to do?

choices.label: Track an outbreak's origin and spread
choices.feedback: Sequenced samples fed a living tree (PANGO lineages) for every COVID variant of concern.

choices.label: Rank threatened species for conservation
choices.feedback: EDGE scores rank species by evolutionary distinctiveness.

choices.label: Prosecute a timber or ivory shipment
choices.feedback: DNA signatures match the goods to source populations.

choices.label: Find the next antibiotic
choices.feedback: Screen the relatives of species that already made one.

epi.text: Origin and spread tracked within weeks — the same pipeline traced Ebola's re-ignitions and polio's export chains.

edge.text: Losing the aye-aye — its own branch for ~60 million years — costs more tree than losing another rodent; the logic sets zoo and seed-bank priorities.

forensic.text: Phylogeography into prosecutions — forensics from branch tips.

med.text: Phylogenetic autocorrelation of biochemistry — the search starts in the genus that already made an antibiotic.

config.why: One reconstruction, four payoffs: epidemiology, conservation, forensics and medicine all borrow the same branching history.
